page.overview:
Who is Aaf Capmi Piap?

From the Witch's Road, she walked to Earth without any knowledge of her true identity. She was adopted by Philip Hawlut, also oblivious to her real origin, and was given the name Amaranth, meaning "everlasting." She was eventually sent by Agatha Harkness to become Wanda Maximoff's new apprentice. She also became an ally of the New Champions.

Some time later, Amaranth was entrusted with the stewardship of the Elder God Chthon's realm, the Flickering Realms, by her former teacher, the Scarlet Witch. She was tasked with rebuilding the realm.
